title: JailBreakV: A Benchmark for Assessing the Robustness of MultiModal Large Language Models against Jailbreak Attacks

bias_targets.target: Bias and Discrimination (Racial bias, personal prejudice, group-targeted discrimination)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of multimodal and text-based jailbreak prompts designed to induce the model to generate content that violates the 'Bias' safety policy.
Evaluating model robustness by calculating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of malicious jailbreak queries intended to elicit derogatory language directed at specific groups.
